# Oludare Investment Ltd (OIL)

## About
Oludare Investment Ltd (RC 1042746) is a premier heavy-duty truck and machinery dealer based in Lagos, Nigeria. They specialize in direct supply, sales, and maintenance of Shacman and HOWO Sino Trucks.

## Location
- Address: 209, Lagos/Ibadan Express Way, Beside Total KFC Filling Station, Ojodu Berger, Lagos State, Nigeria.
- Service Area: Nationwide delivery to all 36 states in Nigeria.

## Core Products
- Shacman Trucks: F3000, X3000 Dump Trucks, Tippers.
- HOWO Sino Trucks: 371HP, 420HP models, Tractor Heads.
- Construction Machinery: XCMG Excavators, SDLG Wheel Loaders, Shantui Bulldozers.
- Specialized Equipment: Cement Mixers, CNG Trucks, Low-bed Trailers.
- Spare Parts: Genuine HOWO engines (WD615.47), gearboxes, and cabins.
